nodes.label: Task K0 Report — three consumeListener arg bugs fixed, contract defined (commit 4f2594e)
SplitDataView consumeListener contract: (chunkIndex, logicalOffset, byteLength) per released chunk
nodes.rationale: The contract was entirely implicit before K0 (zero call sites in src/); it was defined through TDD. Three bugs were fixed in one expression: live mutable buffers array passed instead of chunkIndex; hardcoded 0 instead of logicalOffset; an always-negative Math.min expression instead of byteLength. Prerequisite for slice K's chunk-release machinery, which relies on the listener to let external holders drop chunk references.
